lines: I’m drawn to privacy, security, anonymity, systems, automation and the difficult parts most people never look at.
I like understanding how things actually behave under the surface, finding where assumptions fail, and turning that understanding into cleaner, stronger systems.
I tend to go deep: browsers, networks, cryptography, low-level behavior, infrastructure and anything that rewards obsessive curiosity.

projects.name: THOTH BROWSER
projects.subtitle: Privacy-first browser project
projects.description: A browser project built around compartmentalization, isolation, anti-correlation design and stronger privacy boundaries.
